description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for C# code that checks for specific attributes and inheritance patterns in interface, class, struct, and record declarations within the Orleans project. It reports diagnostics when certain conditions are met, such as missing attributes or inheritance from specific interfaces or classes.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer class that inspects C# syntax nodes to enforce attribute and inheritance rules for Orleans grain interfaces and classes.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node to determine if it matches specific criteria for Orleans grain interfaces or classes and reports diagnostics accordingly.

methods.name: GetArity
methods.description: Calculates the arity (nesting depth) of a type declaration.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the namespace and nesting hierarchy of a type declaration.

methods.name: ReportFor
methods.description: Creates and reports a diagnostic message for a specific syntax node, including details like type name, namespace, and arity.
